meta.title: CODEX — Software, Branding & Marketing Agency

about.label: About
about.title: A digital agency built like a product team.
about.intro: CODEX brings development, brand and marketing teams together so every project ships faster and grows longer.
about.story1: CODEX started as a small team of developers who kept getting asked for the same thing: a partner who could build the product, shape the brand and bring the customers — without three agencies blaming each other.
about.story2: Today we're three in-house teams working from one roadmap for clients across Egypt, Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Kuwait and Oman.
